Get all resolution-0 root cells

Source: R/info.R
a5_get_res0_cells.Rd

Returns the 12 root cells corresponding to the 12 faces of the dodecahedron.

Usage

a5_get_res0_cells()

Value

An a5_cell vector of length 12.

Examples

a5_get_res0_cells()
#> <a5_cell[12]>
#>  [1] 200000000000000  600000000000000  a00000000000000  e00000000000000 
#>  [5] 1200000000000000 1600000000000000 1a00000000000000 1e00000000000000
#>  [9] 2200000000000000 2600000000000000 2a00000000000000 2e00000000000000
